ca-dmv-req-2026-3933.title: CA DMV Public Records Act request: M1 & M2 knowledge test details
ca-dmv-req-2026-3933.description: The California DMV's written reply to a public records request about its motorcycle knowledge test, including how many questions it has.
ca-dmv-req-2026-3933.intro: LanternCert sent the California DMV a Public Records Act request, REQ-2026-3933, asking how many questions are on its motorcycle knowledge test and how many it takes to pass. This is CA DMV's full response, with names and email addresses redacted.
